purpose: Freeways TIGER records by name alone. A TIGER primary road (MTFCC S1100) is a limited-access highway by the Census definition; where its name carries no route number the atlas used to draw it only as a context hairline. These entries say which of those names are a signed route under another name, and which spellings are one road. Every other such name becomes a route of its own, labelled by its name.
source: US Census TIGER/Line 2025 primary and secondary roads
rule: A named primary road is added only where no numbered route already runs within 0.4 km of it, so a name TIGER puts on an Interstate's other carriageway, or on a stretch it also files under a number, adds nothing.
